result.name: College of Arts and Humanities General Education
result.templateAssets:
[{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students who have listed on their transcript completion of an ADT or IGETC, CSUGE, or CALGETC certification will waive all General Education except for the following: World Languages (L), Writing in the Discipline (WD), Information and Media Literacy Advanced (IMLA), and Community Service Activity (CSAC).


Writing requirements are determined by writing pathways chosen by the student.


**First Year Seminar (FYS)** is waived for transfer students with 12 or more semester units earned upon transfer. First year students with any number of units are still required to take a FYS course.


**C, H, S, N, L** may not double count with each other. Each course fulfilling this section must be distinct from each other course in this section.

**APW, CPI, ESS, TG** may double count in this section OR in the section above. A course meeting a requirement in this section may only fulfill one other requirement in this section or the above section.


**QRF, QRE** may double count with any requirement. When transferring two QRF courses, both QRF and QRE will be fulfilled upon transfer.
